_about: Sources for the Terra Ledger catalogue. scripts/catalog-fetch.mjs downloads or renders every image into public/assets/nft/ and writes public/assets/nft/catalog.csv; then run npm run catalog:import. Prices marked in tez are demo prices unless they come from terraledger.org.

site.title: Cascade House
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: A 5,100 sq ft desert-modern residence on a half-acre lot, held on a five-year corporate lease with annual CPI escalation. Scottsdale, Arizona · single-family residential · valuation US$4.20M · target yield 6.1% · US$500 per token.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: The Mercer Block
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: Ground-floor retail with fourteen floors of office above, 91% leased with a 6.2-year weighted average lease term. Austin, Texas · mixed-use commercial · valuation US$28.60M · target yield 7.4% · US$500 per token.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: Harborline Lofts
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: Forty-two converted warehouse loft units two blocks from the waterfront. Stabilised occupancy of 96% across the last eight quarters. Seattle, Washington · multifamily residential · valuation US$16.75M · target yield 5.8% · US$500 per token.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: Juniper Ridge
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: A six-bedroom timber lodge operating on the short-term rental market. Seasonal revenue, distributed monthly. Park City, Utah · short-term rental · valuation US$3.10M · target yield 9.2% · fully subscribed.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: Olive Court
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: A recently completed residence in a supply-constrained submarket, acquired below replacement cost and leased to a relocation-services tenant. Coral Gables, Florida · single-family residential · valuation US$5.90M · target yield 6.6% · US$500 per token.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: The Foundry
site.creator: Terra Ledger
site.description: A former foundry building undergoing conversion to creative office. Currently in diligence; issuance deploys post-occupancy certificate. Brooklyn, New York · industrial conversion · valuation US$41.30M · opens Q1 · minimum US$2,500. Token supply and price to be set.
site.attribution: Photo: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. Illustrative; replace with photographs of the property.

site.title: Cadastral
site.creator: Ilse Verhoeven
site.description: Contour fields generated from the public survey data of the six counties we hold property in. Generative, digital-native.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.title: Ground Truth
site.creator: Mateo Salinas
site.description: Oil and graphite on linen, 140 × 110 cm. A physical, custodied work held in bonded, climate-controlled storage in Austin.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.title: Refraction Study
site.creator: Noor Haddad
site.description: Real-time WebGL, minted with its own renderer: interlocking translucent solids resolved live in the browser.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.title: Signal Decay
site.creator: June Okafor
site.description: Pen-plotter drawing, archived as vector. The opening collection; ships as a vector archive for personal plotting.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.title: Chroma Deed
site.creator: Beatriz Lund
site.description: Acrylic on board, 90 × 90 cm. Painted responses to twenty-four deeds drawn from the county records, with annual condition reporting.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.title: Ribbonwork
site.creator: Kenji Alvarez
site.description: Motion work, 12-second loop, with renderer and frames held on-chain. Opens Q4; price to be set.
site.attribution: Image: Unsplash, as shown on terraledger.org. A stand-in for the original work; replace before sale.

site.description: Dealer character from Twenty-One Showdown, the multiplayer blackjack-style card game with woodland characters: two to four players, four table levels, and a server that deals every card.

site.title: Elemental RPS Arena
site.creator: Terra Ledger Games
site.description: Key art for Elemental RPS Arena, a rock-paper-scissors ladder with 15 collectible tiers, from the Copper Sigil (1 in 2) to the Eternal Singularity (1 in 32,768). Every win unlocks a rarer collectible: claim it, or risk it for the next tier.
